title: 1M Context Window

body.text: scale of a million tokens — a whole book, an entire code repo, or hours of video
in one conversation, with no need to chop documents into pieces like before.

example: "Upload an 800-page manual and ask: 'Does the return policy in Chapter 12 conflict with the FAQ at the end anywhere?'"

title: Get value from a large context

body.text: Work unlocked by a large context:
finding inconsistencies across long documents, analyzing an entire codebase, summarizing long meeting videos
— but accuracy can be lower in the middle than at the start/end, so for key questions point to the location, like 'focus mainly on Chapter 12.'

example: "Analyze this whole repo: what's the architecture, and where are patterns used inconsistently?"

question: What does a 1M context window mean?

options.text: It can take book-scale input in one conversation

question: Which work benefits most from a large context?
What's a technique to improve accuracy when a document is very long?

options.text: Point to the location to focus on, like which chapter is key

question: You have hundreds of pages of documents to analyze together. Which strength helps?

options.text: Cut it down to one page

question: How do you get value from a large context?

options.text: Include all the relevant documents, then ask cross-file questions
Add as much irrelevant data as possible
